newsitem.title: USA: NIKE earns $177 million, sales up 55 percent.
newsitem.headline: NIKE earns $177 million, sales up 55 percent.

text.p: NIKE, Inc. said Wednesday its profits leaped 80 percent in its second quarter to $176.9 million, up from $97.8 million a year earlier, as sales jumped by 55 percent.

The maker of athletic footwear and apparel said sales totaled $2.10 billion, up from $1.36 billion a year earlier, and orders for the period from December 1996 through April 1997 totaled $4.1 billion, up 54 percent from the year-earlier pace.
The company's income and sales were both records. NIKE's per share earnings totalled 60 cents a share, up from 34 cents a year earlier.
NIKE shares closed at $55.125, up $2.50, on the New York Stock Exchange. The company reported results after the market closed.

In the second quarter, its U.S. athletic footwear and apparel revenues totalled $1.19 billion, an increase of 63 percent. International athletic footwear and apparel revenues gained 60 percent to $779.3 million.
The company said sales of running shoes increased by 90 percent and basketball shoes by 38 percent in the United States. Sales in Japan rose by 20 percent, NIKE said.
